name: T & I Global Limited
about: T & I Global Limited manufactures and trades in tea and coconut processing machinery in India and internationally. It operates through Tea Machinery and Tea segments. The company offers CTC machinery comprising continuous withering systems, rotorvane, dual stage and vibro fluid bed dryers, pass air heaters, automatic milling and chasing machines, tea sorting, CTC segments, and storage solutions; orthodox and green tea machinery, such as rolling tables, roaster and coolers, combination and ECP dryers, optical color sorters, and other sorting machines; and mini tea processing equipment. It also provides automation products comprising smart feed and discharge, coal saver, dryer and CFM automation machines; blending and packing products, such as blending machines and bag flattener conveyors; and turnkey solutions, which include boilers, steam fittings, electricals, and factory design related solutions, as well as installing, commissioning, and training services. In addition, the company offers industrial dryers; agro and coconut processing machineries; drying and processing solutions for spices, herbs, coconut, fruits and vegetables; banana dehydration lines; and super absorbent polymers dryers. Further, it engages in the cultivation, manufacturing, and trading of tea. T & I Global Limited was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
